text: The homotopy pushout (or homotopy cofiber) A ⊔_C B differs from the ordinary pushout because:
choices: it uses identity types instead of set-quotients
it avoids collapsing higher homotopy content of C by keeping track of the maps as paths
it is only defined for propositions
it requires A and B to be Kan complexes
explanation: The homotopy pushout records the path data from the two maps C→A and C→B, not just their images. In HoTT, the HIT pushout automatically gives the homotopy pushout.
